method.primary: Every observed single-token gap<=100ms and scheduled TTFT<=1s per request
method.goodput_denominator: Sum measured arrival windows, 720s per role for all six paired confirmations
method.percentiles: Retain per window; never average or reconstruct pooled quantiles from quantiles
method.source_validation: Small reports/audits verified by SHA; existing independent raw audits reused, raw sizes checked, no raw replay or full raw rehash
method.lifetimes: One service startup per role/orientation; seeds share startup; serial separate
method.claim: Registered application scenario, not maximum capacity/global best native

native.percentile_policy: No averaging or pooling of per-window percentiles; inspect each retained window.
